verdict.rationale: Spline is a design tool, so exporting production assets is a fair question to ask of it. Its documented exports are web-delivery formats: a self-hosted ZIP, the spline-viewer web component, and code exports (Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js, react-three-fiber). Nothing in the evidence shows PNG, SVG or PDF export, per-layer export presets, scale options or slices.

support.subject: As a designer, I can export production assets — PNG, SVG, PDF, and more — with per-layer presets, scales, and slices
